b1-39-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Nerves at the Office
b1-39-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how your presentation at the office went. You were very nervous before it, and you turned red when your boss asked a question.
b1-39-01.prompt: Tell Meg how you felt before the presentation and when your boss asked a question.
cues: Say you got nervous before the presentation
Say what happened when your boss asked a question
b1-39-01.target: Me puse muy nervioso antes de la presentación y me puse rojo cuando mi jefe hizo una pregunta.
b1-39-01.english: I got very nervous before the presentation and I turned red when my boss asked a question.
b1-39-01.canDo: I can use ponerse + adjective for sudden changes of mood, health and appearance.

b1-39-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Asleep on the Metro
b1-39-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you were late for the dinner with his friends. After your classes you fell asleep on the metro.
b1-39-02.prompt: Tell Carlos why you were late.
cues: Say where and when it happened
b1-39-02.target: Me quedé dormida en el metro después de mis clases.
b1-39-02.english: I fell asleep on the metro after my classes.
b1-39-02.canDo: I can use quedarse for the state that results from an event.

b1-39-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Neighbour Has Changed
b1-39-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks about your neighbour in Budapest. Since last year he has become very serious, and he hardly talks to anyone.
b1-39-03.prompt: Tell Carlos how your neighbour has changed.
b1-39-03.target: Mi vecino se ha vuelto muy serio y casi no habla con nadie.
b1-39-03.english: My neighbour has become very serious and hardly talks to anyone.
b1-39-03.canDo: I can use volverse + adjective for deep, lasting changes in character.

b1-39-04.title: Communicative Challenge: From Student to Head of the School
b1-39-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about a friend of a colleague who is now the head of a school. She studied for ten years, became a teacher and later became head of the school.
b1-39-04.prompt: Tell Meg how she got there.
b1-39-04.target: Estudió diez años, se hizo profesora y llegó a ser directora de la escuela.
b1-39-04.english: She studied for ten years, became a teacher and came to be head of the school.
b1-39-04.canDo: I can use hacerse and convertirse en, and say llegar a ser for the high point of a long effort.

b1-39-05.title: Communicative Challenge: How My Sister Has Changed
b1-39-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how your sister Kaylee has changed. She was always very calm, but now she gets nervous easily, and last year she became a teacher.
b1-39-05.prompt: Tell Carlos how Kaylee was, how she is now and what she became.
cues: Say what she became last year
b1-39-05.target: Kaylee siempre fue muy tranquila, pero ahora se pone nerviosa con facilidad, y el año pasado se hizo profesora.
b1-39-05.english: Kaylee was always very calm, but now she gets nervous easily, and last year she became a teacher.
b1-39-05.canDo: I can choose between ponerse, quedarse, volverse, hacerse and convertirse en.

b1-39-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day at the Office
b1-39-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what happened at the office today. Your boss got furious when he read the report and then was left speechless. Later the project turned into a success.
b1-39-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what your boss did and what the project became.
b1-39-consolidation.target: Mi jefe se puso furioso al leer el informe y luego se quedó sin palabras. Después el proyecto se convirtió en un éxito.
b1-39-consolidation.english: My boss got furious when he read the report and then was left speechless. Afterwards the project turned into a success.
b1-39-consolidation.canDo: I can describe how people and things change, choosing the right verb.
